connections: The nameplate_body is the base solid.
The left_slot, right_slot, and vent_holes are subtractive features from the nameplate_body.
edit_rules: Changing ASSUMED_thickness_mm affects the depth of all features.
Changing ASSUMED_slot_width_mm and ASSUMED_slot_height_mm affects the size of the end slots.
Changing ASSUMED_hole_diameter_mm affects the size of the vent holes.
Changing ASSUMED_hole_spacing_mm affects the distance between the vent holes.
